post.title: How Visa made $20B in profit without lending a dime
post.ig:
Visa lends $0. It still made $20.1 billion in net income in fiscal 2025.
Your bank issues the card, lends the money and keeps your interest. Visa charges banks for using its network.
FY2025 gross fees: $55.75B, minus $15.75B in bank incentives = $40.0B net revenue.
Visa's cut: about 28 cents per $100 of its $14.2 trillion in payments volume, and about half became profit.
Sources: Visa FY2025 Form 10-K and full-year earnings release.
